answer: Proposal: fee-burn escrow. Each identity burns a fee into the epoch pool — the jetty where all stakes moor — and rewards pay strictly as a share of what that same key burned; no ivory-tower promise counts. Keys that wander in without burning get zero weight. Clones burning n fees receive only their own burns back, so net gain is zero: reward ≤ contribution is what the contract enforces, making extra identities worthless, not costly. Assumption: the fee token cannot be printed or subsidized. Leak: a funded whale regains proportional share, so cap per-key weight.
